name: MaxAI
title: MaxAI - On-Device Autonomous AI Runtime & Local Agent System
technologies: Kotlin, C++, LiteRT (TFLite), GGUF, On-Device LLM, Android NPU/GPU
description: Autonomous on-device neural runtime executing quantized GGUF and LiteRT models directly on mobile GPUs and NPUs with zero cloud latency, local tool calling, and embedded privacy.

details.problem: Cloud-dependent AI services impose severe network latency, demand persistent internet connectivity, leak confidential personal telemetry, and incur recurring cloud fees.
details.solution: Architected an ultra-fast on-device neural engine utilizing LiteRT and GGUF runtimes directly on Android hardware with sub-second token generation, offline function calling, and secure local embeddings.
details.impact: Delivers zero-latency, private, and 100% offline intelligence for autonomous local tasks directly on personal devices without tracking or cloud reliance.

name: CellLock5G
title: CellLock5G - 5G Radio & Carrier Aggregation Telemetry
technologies: Android Native, C++, Qualcomm/MTK Radio, Shell
description: Cellular radio optimization suite that locks 5G Standalone (SA) and Non-Standalone (NSA) frequency bands (n28/n78), forces LTE carrier aggregation, and visualizes live RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR signal telemetry.

details.problem: In areas with fluctuating cellular coverage, modern phones frequently drop to slow fallback bands instead of staying on high-throughput 5G sub-6GHz frequencies.
details.solution: Engineered low-level modem AT-command hooks and native Android radio interfaces to pin modem hardware to high-capacity NR bands (n78/n28) with live RF diagnostics.
details.impact: Improves sustained mobile network bandwidth by up to 300% and provides field RF telemetry for wireless site testers.

name: HomeMax
title: HomeMax - 50-Channel Industrial IoT Automation System
technologies: C++, Arduino Mega, ESP8266/ESP32, EEPROM, WebSockets
description: Industrial hardware controller managing up to 50 physical high-load electrical relays. Built with non-volatile EEPROM state persistence ensuring instantaneous recovery of relay states after abrupt electrical power failures.

details.problem: Sudden power outages in automation setups cause controllers to reboot into indeterminate relay states, risking electrical hazards and equipment damage.
details.solution: Implemented hardware interrupt handlers and cyclical EEPROM memory blocks that store relay latch states in real time with zero-latency local WebSocket and MQTT controls.
details.impact: Zero state loss across power resets, managing 50 independent circuits with high electrical isolation.

name: CellWatchPro
title: CellWatchPro - Cellular Signal & Tower Diagnostics
technologies: Kotlin, Android TelephonyManager, SQLite, RF Analytics
description: Professional cellular field diagnostic app measuring Physical Cell ID (PCI), Timing Advance (TA), channel quality indicators (CQI), and signal degradation across 4G LTE and 5G network infrastructure.

details.problem: Telecommunication engineers require dedicated handheld drive-test equipment costing thousands of dollars to evaluate cellular deadzones.
details.solution: Built a native Android suite leveraging low-level Telephony API cell info to log, map, and export cellular RF parameters to CSV/JSON in real time.
details.impact: Used by technicians to identify cell tower handovers, boundary interference, and coverage deadzones.

name: Amul-Dairy-Platform
title: Amul Dairy Enterprise Milk Collection & Sensor API
technologies: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, IoT Serial Sensors
description: Enterprise backend and API architecture for cooperative milk collection stations, automating digital weighing scale capture, fat/SNF spectrometer readings, and daily farmer payout calculations.

details.problem: Manual recording of milk weights and fat metrics at rural collection centers led to transcription errors and payment delays for local dairy farmers.
details.solution: Created automated serial RS-232 hardware listeners coupled with secure REST microservices for instant data capture and automated digital payment vouchers.
details.impact: Eliminated billing discrepancies across rural collection centers and reduced milk intake processing time by 60%.

name: MaxFit
title: MaxFit - Gym Management SaaS & Member Biometrics
technologies: Kotlin, Android SDK, Firebase Firestore, Biometrics
description: Production-ready fitness center management platform featuring biometric QR attendance check-ins, automated subscription renewal billing, workout progression analytics, and real-time revenue dashboards.

details.problem: Gym owners struggle with paper-based attendance, expired membership tracking, and unauthorized guest entries.
details.solution: Developed an all-in-one Android management system paired with real-time cloud sync, automated WhatsApp/SMS renewal reminders, and member check-in portals.
details.impact: Deployed in active fitness facilities serving hundreds of daily active members with zero attendance errors.

name: MaxHive-OSINT
title: MaxHive - Threat Intelligence & Digital Footprint Platform
technologies: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
description: Modern intelligence analysis dashboard offering digital footprint visualization, asset discovery, breach exposure indexing, credit wallet billing, and comprehensive developer documentation.

details.problem: Security teams need a unified, clean interface to investigate digital footprints and correlate asset threat data without fragmented CLI tools.
details.solution: Designed a dark cybernetic UI system (MaxHive) with real-time API integrations, responsive data tables, robotic status indicators, and modular toolkits.
details.impact: Accelerates security intelligence investigations and serves as the UI benchmark for high-performance dashboards.

name: IPCAI-Studio
title: IPCAI - Edge AI Smart IP Camera Video Studio
description: Edge camera management studio featuring multi-channel RTSP stream ingestion, automated OpenIPC device discovery, computer-vision motion alerting, and local storage recording.

details.problem: Standard CCTV systems lock users into proprietary cloud subscriptions with sluggish mobile playback and high bandwidth costs.
details.solution: Built a lightweight Python-based streaming studio interfacing directly with OpenIPC hardware, providing local motion segmentation and low-latency H.264 playback.
details.impact: Enables low-cost embedded hardware to perform smart video analytics on local premises with zero monthly fees.

name: LuCI-Cyber-Theme
title: OpenWrt LuCI Cyber Theme & Router Firmware
technologies: OpenWrt, LuCI, CSS3, JavaScript, Linux Kernel
description: High-tech responsive dark glassmorphic web dashboard for OpenWrt embedded Linux routers. Displays real-time bandwidth consumption graphs, active client DHCP mapping, and hardware resource telemetry.

details.problem: Default OpenWrt router interfaces are dated, desktop-only, and hard to inspect on modern smartphones and tablets.
details.solution: Re-engineered the LuCI web interface with modern CSS grid layouts, real-time SVG throughput meters, and mobile-first touch navigation.
details.impact: Adopted by home-lab network enthusiasts and OpenWrt users seeking a sleek, informative network control panel.

name: Adb_on_wrt
title: Adb_on_wrt - Router Android Bridge & Cellular Failover
technologies: OpenWrt C/Makefile, Linux Shell, ADB Bridge
description: Router package enabling automated Android USB device bridging, remote ADB port management, and seamless 4G/5G USB tethering WAN failover during wired ISP outages.

details.problem: When fiber or broadband connections fail, manual failover to cellular hotspots disrupts home and enterprise servers.
details.solution: Engineered automated kernel module rules and hotplug scripts to detect USB-connected Android modems and instantly reroute default gateway traffic.
details.impact: Delivers uninterrupted internet availability with sub-second failover for mission-critical remote servers.

name: Go-Port-Proxy
title: Go Port Proxy Multiplexer - Low-Latency Reverse Proxy
description: Asynchronous reverse proxy and port multiplexer capable of handling 10,000+ simultaneous connections with microsecond latency, zero garbage collection pauses, and minimal memory usage.

details.problem: Heavyweight reverse proxies consume significant memory on embedded edge devices and small cloud VPS instances.
details.solution: Crafted a minimalist Go daemon utilizing non-blocking socket I/O, ring buffers, and goroutine pools for efficient packet routing.
details.impact: Operates with under 15MB RAM while routing thousands of concurrent TCP/UDP streams.

name: MAXTER

details.solution: Architected a streamlined ZSH configuration engine optimized for ARM processors with instantaneous startup times and intuitive shortcuts.
details.impact: Downloaded and used by thousands of mobile developers worldwide for on-the-go coding and remote server management.

name: Qualcomm-Custom-Kernel
title: Qualcomm MSM8916 Custom Kernel & AOSP Device Trees

details.solution: Ported clean upstream Linux kernel patches, authored custom device trees, and tuned memory compression algorithms to breathe new life into hardware.

name: MaxKit-Android
title: MaxKit - Android Hardware Systems & Diagnostics Toolkit

description: Native Android diagnostic inspection app testing multi-touch sensitivity, gyroscope/accelerometer calibration, deep battery cycle health, and background service profiling.

details.problem: Refurbished mobile hardware inspection requires running multiple disparate diagnostic tools.
details.solution: Constructed an automated hardware sensor audit suite that tests display pixels, touch digitizers, sensors, and cameras with unified pass/fail reports.
details.impact: Used for quick device certification and hardware quality validation.

name: SDX65-Modem-Pipeline
title: Qualcomm SDX65 5G Modem Firmware Recovery Pipeline
technologies: Python, Qualcomm EDL Protocol, Serial Minicom, Linux
description: Automated firmware analysis and unbricking pipeline for Qualcomm SDX65 5G modems in outdoor CPE units, enabling partition extraction, bootloader verification, and automated serial recovery.

details.problem: Corrupted OTA updates on enterprise outdoor 5G cellular antennas leave expensive hardware completely unresponsive in boot loops.
details.solution: Created Python EDL automation scripts that identify emergency download mode, flash verified raw partition tables, and test modem AT diagnostics.
details.impact: Recovers valuable telecommunications equipment without requiring factory return or chip desoldering.

name: Alcohol-Safety-Interlock
title: Alcohol Detection Safety Ignition Cutoff Interlock
technologies: C++, Arduino Uno, MQ-3 Gas Sensor, Relays, LCD
description: Automotive safety system evaluating driver breath alcohol concentration via MQ-3 sensor, engaging an electrical ignition relay cutoff and audio buzzer if levels exceed legal thresholds.

details.solution: Designed an embedded microcontroller module that samples driver cabin breath, locks engine ignition circuits, and displays warning metrics on an LCD screen.
details.impact: Proven prototype demonstrating automated hardware enforcement of transportation safety.

details.solution: Programmed high-frequency timers on AVR microcontrollers to calculate sonic return echoes with sub-millimeter precision.

details.solution: Built a lightweight, mobile-first offline PWA enabling commuters to search contacts and timetables even on 2G connections.
